newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel jails for life accomplices to Hamas bombers.
newsitem.headline: Israel jails for life accomplices to Hamas bombers.

text.p: An Israeli military court sentenced two Palestinians on Sunday to life imprisonment for aiding Hamas Islamic suicide bombers who killed scores in the Jewish state in February and March, the army said.
"Sentenced to two consecutive life sentences each were Aqram Ibrahim Kawasama and Imand Rassam of the (Arab East Jerusalem) neighbourhood of Ras al-Amud," an army spokeswoman said.
She said they acted as drivers for suicide bombers in three of the four blasts that rocked Israel in February and March.
A total of 59 people were killed in the four bombings, which undermined Israeli support for then-prime minister Shimon Peres, defeated by hardliner Benjamin Netanyahu in May elections.
On Thursday the militant Hamas organisation, scathingly criticising Israel-PLO peace moves, vowed to resume armed struggle against the Jewish state.
